title: Movie Recommendation System
summary: A movie discovery app that helps users find their next favourite film by recommending movies similar to their selection.
points: Built a content based movie recommendation system that helps users discover films based on their interests.
Processed movie details such as genres, keywords, cast and crew to represent each film through its content.
Used TF-IDF to convert movie metadata into numerical vectors and cosine similarity to measure how closely movies are related.
Ranked movies by similarity and returned the five closest recommendations for the selected film.
Integrated the TMDB API to display movie posters and make recommendations more visual and engaging.
Deployed the application using Streamlit, allowing users to select a movie and explore similar films online.
